# Operational Assessment: Commercial Lending Intake Workflow
Review of Regional Commercial Credit Facility Operations

## Intake Baseline Metrics
Data sampled across 420 commercial loan applications processed between 01/05/2026 and 02/27/2026.

| Stage | Target Duration | Actual Mean Duration | Variance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Document Collation | 24 hours | 58 hours | +34 hours |
| KYC / CIP Screening | 4 hours | 6 hours | +2 hours |
| Initial Financial Spread | 8 hours | 11 hours | +3 hours |
| Senior Underwriter Assignment | 2 hours | 3 hours | +1 hour |

## Identified Bottlenecks
- Document collation accounts for 74 percent of all intake cycle delays due to manual portal uploads.
- Intake specialists currently wait for physical wet-ink signatures before initiating Patriot Act Customer Identification Program checks.
- File transfers between the front-office portal and credit underwriting databases fail automated validation in 18 percent of cases.

## Procedural Compliance and Risk
Interviews conducted on 03/03/2026 identified recurring procedural non-compliance in client information gathering:
- To accelerate high-value approvals, analysts may waive FinCEN beneficial ownership certification for privately held entity applicants borrowing under $250,000.
- Incomplete packages are logged as pending without triggering formal notices of incomplete application under Regulation B guidelines.

## Remediation Next Steps
- Reassign two intake clerks to financial spreading because financial spreading causes the largest mean delay across all pipeline stages.
- Configure core enterprise software to cross-check entity registration numbers directly with state databases prior to routing files.

errors.quote: analysts may waive FinCEN beneficial ownership certification for privately held entity applicants borrowing under $250,000.
errors.explanation: Federal FinCEN Customer Due Diligence (CDD) rules require covered financial institutions to identify and verify beneficial ownership for legal entity customers regardless of loan size; staff cannot selectively waive this federal requirement based on dollar thresholds.
errors.fix: analysts must collect FinCEN beneficial ownership certification for all covered legal entity applicants regardless of loan amount.

errors.quote: Reassign two intake clerks to financial spreading because financial spreading causes the largest mean delay across all pipeline stages
errors.explanation: The intake baseline metrics table shows that document collation has an actual mean duration of 58 hours (+34 hours variance), whereas financial spreading only has an actual mean duration of 11 hours (+3 hours variance), making document collation the largest delay.
errors.fix: reassign two intake clerks to document collation because document collation causes the largest mean delay across all pipeline stages.
